reason: Adds a Web UI for configuring custom DeepSeek Harness model endpoints, credentials, request protocols, model discovery, and per-model capability settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用于创建自定义模型端点、获取模型并配置请求与模型能力参数的 Web 设置页面。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness Web settings page for creating custom model endpoints, discovering models, and configuring request and model capability parameters.

capabilities: Creates and edits custom model endpoints
Stores and uses API keys through the host credential system
Sends model requests to configured external URLs
Fetches available models from endpoint GET /models
Applies custom request headers and model capacity parameters
